extends RefCounted
class_name SaveManager

static func _normalize_path(path: String, binary: bool) -> String:
	var ext = ".res" if binary else ".tres"
	var current_ext = path.get_extension()
	if current_ext == "res" or current_ext == "tres":
		return path.get_basename() + ext
	return path + ext

static func _resolve_path(path: String) -> String:
	var ext = path.get_extension()
	if ext == "res" or ext == "tres":
		return path
	var tres = path + ".tres"
	var res = path + ".res"
	if FileAccess.file_exists(tres):
		return tres
	return res

static func save_to_disk(data: GameSaveData, path: String, binary: bool) -> int:
	path = _normalize_path(path, binary)
	return ResourceSaver.save(data, path)

static func load_from_disk(path: String) -> GameSaveData:
	path = _resolve_path(path)
	return ResourceLoader.load(path) as GameSaveData

static func compute_hash(data: GameSaveData) -> String:
	var ctx = HashingContext.new()
	ctx.start(HashingContext.HASH_SHA256)
	
	ctx.update(str(data.player_position).to_utf8_buffer())
	ctx.update(str(data.unlocked_levels).to_utf8_buffer())
	ctx.update(str(data.last_played).to_utf8_buffer())
	
	for item in data.inventory:
		ctx.update(str(item.id).to_utf8_buffer())
		ctx.update(str(item.quantity).to_utf8_buffer())
		ctx.update(str(item.rarity).to_utf8_buffer())
	
	var hash_bytes = ctx.finish()
	return hash_bytes.hex_encode()
